prompt:
Create one complete Walkamon Friend and Battle/PvP icon spritesheet.
Use the reference images as style reference only: cozy fantasy pet-game UI, soft chibi, warm friendly hand-painted item icons. Do not copy pet shapes directly into every icon.

Output exactly one transparent PNG spritesheet. Layout: 6 columns x 4 rows, 24 equal cells. Each icon centered with consistent padding. Real alpha transparency. No checkerboard, no labels, no captions, no row titles, no UI frame around cells, no background decorations, no overlap, no cropped icons.

Strict no-text rule: do not draw any text, letters, numbers, UI words, labels, captions, signatures, or marks that resemble writing. Use pictorial symbols only. Banners, scrolls, flags, shields, badges, and envelopes must be blank or contain only paw/leaf/heart pictograms.

Style: cozy mobile game UI icon style, cute fantasy pet game feeling, rounded shapes, soft highlights, gentle shadows, consistent line weight, readable at 32px/64px/128px. Warm cream, soft green, peach, gold, gentle brown, sky blue, moon blue, lavender, terracotta accents. No harsh neon, no corporate flat style, no realism, no heavy black outlines.

Soft battle rule: this is a cute pet training game, not a violent combat game. Make battle icons playful, friendly, rounded, and safe. Avoid realistic weapons, blood, sharp aggression, scary expressions, dark war imagery, or violent combat symbols. Training sticks must look soft and toy-like.

Grid order, left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1 Friend/Social: friend two cozy pet silhouettes or rounded spirit heads; add friend with plus badge; remove friend with minus badge; friend request envelope with small friend icon; accept friend with checkmark badge; decline friend with soft cross badge.
Row 2 Friend/Social continued: online glowing cozy status dot with tiny pet face; offline muted sleepy status dot with tiny pet face; invite friend invitation envelope with ribbon; block rounded shield with soft stop pictogram; report small warning flag not scary no text; gift friend gift box with friend heart.
Row 3 Friend + Battle start: visit friend pet tiny cozy house with pet paw; battle friendly duel badge with two pet spirit silhouettes; challenge friendly blank banner with paw mark no text; attack cute stylized claw slash or soft training strike non-violent; defense rounded shield with leaf or moon accent; win trophy or smiling victory badge.
Row 4 Battle/PvP: lose softened broken badge or sleepy defeat face not harsh; draw balanced scales or equal-feeling badge without equals sign; battle history scroll with crossed soft training sticks no text; opponent rival pet silhouette facing forward; power glowing power orb or spirit energy core; auto battle circular arrows around small battle badge.

Make all 24 icons visually distinct and cohesive as one Walkamon cozy game UI set.
